citations.claim: victim crossed thin wall: at step 2 it was left of wall, at step 3 it is right of wall
first violating step: victim centre now past wall 0 after crossing between steps 2 and 3

counterfactual.change: reduced striker body 0 vx from 60 to 10; victim no longer launched through wall, no violation in 3 steps

explanation: Heavy striker (m=20, v=60) contacts light victim (m=0.2) at step 2 (gap ~-0.001, touching). Momentum transfer launches victim at ~59 m/s toward thin wall (w=0.1 at x=8.5). Between steps 2 and 3 the victim centre jumps from x~7.2 (left of wall) to x~8.85 (right of wall), crossing the box in one step despite substepping (54-67 substeps), so no_tunneling fires. Slowing the striker removes the high secondary velocity and the failure.

violation.detail: body centre moved through wall 0 between steps 2 and 3

vision_note: The large blue body moves right and strikes the tiny red body just left of the thin vertical wall. By step 3 the red body is on the opposite right side of the wall while the blue body presses against the wall, showing a crossing through the wall.
